title: GET /api/v1/hillclimb/jobs/{id}
spec: Add the single-job endpoint. Unknown ids return 404 not_found with the standard error body.
acceptance_criteria: an existing job is returned as JSON with status 200
an unknown id returns 404 with code not_found
an HTTP test through servertest covers both cases

defects.note: hillclimb.ErrNotFound is not mapped to model.NotFound, so an unknown id returns 500 internal
the test only covers the existing job, not an unknown id
